This is a skill matchup. You have the capabilities to win this matchup. If you hit 3 nails you can jump in with e to proc them and proc electrocute. Use W to escape. With this setup u guarantee to win.
Level 1: Do not trade with her. Her W will allow her to proc elec thanks to the movespeed she gets.
Level 2: Try to hit ur Q's on her when she is on ur side of the lane. Dont try to trade with her when she is on her side. You wont be able to proc Nails if ur overextended.
Level 3-5: You can play the same as level 2, but remember to W when you wanna engage. You can use it a little before u engage as a way to dodge her Charm.
Level 6: You will never hit your ult on ahri. Trading ult with her works since ur R cooldown is 20 seconds shorter. Makes it SUPER easy to track since u have approx 20 seconds after u get ur R back.
After level 6 u can keep fighting her and move with ur jungler. You own the early game.

Really annoying matchup... You cant beat her. Do your very best to farm in this matchup while staying healthy.
If she ever uses her shroud, you need to capitalize on her not having it after.
Level 1: Try to proc elec with 3 q's.
Level 2: try to farm and dont trade too much.
Level 3: If you can proc 3 q's and E1 on her. Try to aim it so u hit her on the side towards your tower. + if you can E2 back on minions ur good. Use W as soon as ur E1 hits. Try to dodge in zig zag to dodge her E.
Level 4-5: same as 3. Don't force plays. Only take highly efficient trades (ONLY WHEN U HIT 3 Q'S)
Level 6: If akali is low u can bait her flash with it but i prefer to save it for jungle skirmish. Ur ult is WAY better in a 2v2 than in a 1v1. Massive value and higher chance of hitting on multiple people.
After level 6 you dont want to trade into akali at all. You want to either let her push and catch waves or hard shove if she isnt in lane. She will stomp u past 6.

Akshan is rough for any assassin to play against. What makes this matchup PLAYABLE is that u have ranged farming. If you hit 3 Q'S on Akshan, you can look for the E. You need to insta W and run away.
Level 1-2: Unplayable. Do not trade.
Level 3-5: if you hit 3 Q's, engage with E and run away with W. MAKE SURE YOU W BEFORE GOING IN since u need to block all the damage u can. if you hit 2 Q's. Do. Not. Go. IN.
Level 6: Go for the usual trades. 3 Q's into E W. If he is 60% HP or less, you have kill threat if u hit 3 Q's, E1 E2 and ignite.
Unless u snowball past 6, its not worth fighting him. Stay healthy for roams. Try to match his roams.

You can kill Anivia early. Once she gets 6 and items its rough tho.. Your E is a blink which means u can use it to dodge her Q. You need to get an early lead.
Level 1: DO NOT LEVEL ABILITY. If anivia gets cocky and walks up to space you, START E and look to trade with her. E engage and auto a couple times and disengage. She will be in your minions too. You have more kill threat than her so trading HP is always good.
Level 2-3: If you ever hit 2-3 Q's, engage with E. You dont wanna E as gap close since she can easily shut ur engage down with Q.
If she is on ur side of the lane, INSTA W and look to hit Q's. If she uses her stun (Q) use ur blink(E) to dodge and trade with her.
4-5: perma fight her. She is ur bitch <3
level 6: This is when the lane gets booooring. She will always ult the wave and push it. You wanna walk up and make her cancel it. If she ults, just walk up and Q. If you hit all go in. Try to bait her to walk up. If her R hits for a lil and then u space her off the wave, It will push to you. Make her walk up.
Past lvl 6 you wanna fight her if she oversteps. But better than trying to kill her, PLAY WITH UR JUNGLER. You two will own the map together.
Annie is annoying to play against. The lower ELO u are the better. If she is bad at cs'ing she will use abilities to farm. When she Q's the wave and loses stun THATS YOUR WINDOW to trade!

Really fun matchup. YOU HARD WIN. If you see a sol, PICK LOCKE. If you hit Q's you all in him. Focus on when he is farming. When minion is low, BOOM Q. If he ever uses Q, you spam those nails and all in. If he wastes his W, ALL IN. You can run circles around him with your W move speed.
Level 1: Try to proc electrocute with tripple Q. You might take a little damage but he has 0 kill threat unlike you
Level 2: You wanna keep poking with Q's Try to walk a lil back and give him false confidence to walk up and then just hard trade. You win. A lil bit harder if he has exhaust or barrier but u still win!
Level 3-5: You win hard. if he ever uses his E (circle thing that stacks) space him off the wave and punish. If he ever uses Q, walk up and hit Q's. He is homeless.
